article.title: Power, on escape, to pursue and retake
article.content:
61Power, on escape, to pursue and retake



Section 61 · Chapter V


(1)If a person in lawful custody escapes or is rescued, the person from whose
                custody he escaped or was rescued may immediately pursue and arrest him in any place in India.

(2)The provisions of section 44 shall apply to arrests under sub-section (1)
                although the person making any such arrest is not acting under a warrant and is not a police officer
                having authority to arrest.
